title: Decimal places 0 is a valid value: compare against null, never truthiness
answers: Decimal places set to 0 has no effect on SQL insight table or Big number
Big number shows 42.195 instead of 42 with style None
decimalPlaces 0 ignored in data visualization formatting
body:
Symptom: Setting Decimal places to 0 on a SQL insight under style None still shows the raw float (42.195 instead of 42) in Big number and table cells.
Root cause: frontend/src/queries/nodes/DataVisualization/dataVisualizationLogic.ts:formatDataWithSettings and the tabularData table cell selector used `decimalPlaces ? ... : data`; 0 is falsy so it fell through to the raw value.
Fix pattern: use `decimalPlaces != null` for configured-check. Do NOT use `toFixed(decimalPlaces ?? 0)`: unset would then truncate every float in tables (tested: unset keeps full precision).
Constraints: Number style already worked because toLocaleString accepts 0. Any new decimalPlaces check in DataVisualization must use null comparison (sqlLineGraphAdapter.ts:formatSqlSeriesValue already does via `?? 3`).
says: Setting decimal places to 0 on Big number shows full float value
SQL insight table ignores zero decimal places formatting and shows raw number
Big number displays 42.195 instead of 42 when decimal places set to zero
Decimal places formatting not applied when value is zero in data table
Insight formatting ignores zero as a valid decimal places configuration
